events.label: Duel starts
events.trigger: Betting closes and both boats pull the net tight.
events.prompt: Two fishermen in wooden boats pull a shared fishing net tight at once, thick wet rope snaps taut with a strong water swoosh and a boat thud, short, close-mic, no voices

events.label: Fishermen heave
events.trigger: During the duel the fishermen grunt as they haul: every 2.6 s, speeding up to 1.3 s as the catch grows.
events.prompt: A strong man hauling a heavy wet rope with all his strength, one short strained effort grunt like hngh or uhh, breathy, no words, close-mic, dry

events.label: Rope creak
events.trigger: Every 2.4 s during the duel, and when a duel ends without a rip.
events.prompt: Thick wet rope and wooden boat hull creaking under a hard tug-of-war strain, single short tense creak, close-mic, dry

events.label: Net rips
events.trigger: Every third result: the shared net tears.
events.prompt: A heavy fishing net stretched between two boats rips apart, loud rope snap and tearing mesh followed by a water splash, short, close-mic

events.label: Catch lands
events.trigger: Other results: the winner hauls the catch into the boat.
events.prompt: A fisherman hauls the whole net of fish into his wooden boat, big wet splash and a thump of fish landing on the deck with water dripping, short, close-mic, no voices

events.label: Background music
events.trigger: Loops in the background while Sound is on.
events.prompt: Calm looping background music bed for a casual mobile fishing-boat contest game: light nautical accordion and plucked strings over a soft steady rhythm, friendly and lively but restrained, mid tempo, no vocals, no build-up, no climax, seamless 30 second loop, consistent from start to end, instrumental only
